item.title: how to get better at data analysis
item.description: okay so im 21 and about to graduate a zoology degree (last assignment due on thursday but i graduate in 2 months). i have really struggled with using r recently because up until 6 months ago if we needed to use r for an assignment the lecturers would basically give us the code and we just had to copy it and change it slightly to fit our data and then suddenly for the last semester they stopped. i understand why they stopped but i mean it was very sudden and because we have always been given the code i am not very good at trying to figure out r. i submitted my dissertation a couple weeks ago and that was the first serious r coding ive done myself and it took me many tears and breakdowns and weeks to figure out just the data analysis because i find that all the ‘help’ websites like stack overflow and similar ones, the way things are described is so complicated. i want to do a postgrad and hopefully a phd and i want to get better at using r because i feel like such a failure for never being able to do it when everyone else seems to be able to. im pretty severely dyslexic and i have adhd and some eye focussing problems that make it extra hard because my vision vibrates when i look at a screen for too long. i do genuinly want to get better at r but i have absolutely no idea how because all the tutorials are so complex and im pretty beginner and most of the time cant even figure out the tutorials. i apologise if this isnt the type of post that is allowed on this sub and i also apologise for spelling errors. i just am so stuck on how to get better. i am a beginner at r but not like a super new beginner because i have been doing it for 3 years and can do some complicated stuff but usually only if i have seen someone elses code. once i know how to do something i wont forget it so i can do nmds ordinations and stuff on r because my diss supervisor showed me his code and using that i learnt how to do it and have been able to expand on that by testing out further nmds stuff. i am a good learner but i just feel like im at a difficult point where im not beginner enough to need help setting directories and stuff but i dont quite understand most of everything else. again i apologise if this isnt the right sub for this but any advice would be appreciated. i love learning new things and i think data analysis is so fun its just so complicated. thank you
